crossRefs.note: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have…
Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
translations.bsb: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?”
translations.kjv: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
translations.asv: Then came Peter and said to him, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? until seven times?
